payload.reason: The evidence provides specific machine learning and deep learning methods used for Recognizing Question Entailment (RQE) in the context of question answering systems.

claims.text: Machine learning methods for RQE include logistic regression classifiers.
Deep learning methods for RQE include neural networks such as Bi-LSTM, GRU, and CNNs.
RQE methods were evaluated using datasets like SNLI, multiNLI, Quora, Clinical-QE, and SemEval-cQA.
Combining information retrieval (IR) models with RQE methods improves the selection of entailed questions and ranking of answers.
